k-sym-PIPI.title: GTA 6 in-game "PIPI coin" ad meme
k-sym-PIPI.sourceSays: Posts say players claim that after finishing GTA 6 story mode, the in-game Instagram can randomly show an ad for a "PIPI coin"; accounts call it GTA's Pepe. Unverified.
k-sym-PIPI.reason: Posts of Nov 19 (11:54-13:11 UTC) relay the claimed in-game ad; the earliest says nobody had launched it yet and the PIPI pools opened about an hour ago. The claim is unverified.
